prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     If object is visible, approach it. Take it if reachable and not heavy. Move to destination. Finally, execute object task. Or, scan and move randomly if no object found.     list of available nodes: <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectReachable    /> <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectHeavy    /> <Action ID = MoveObjectToDestination    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObjectTask    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObjects    /> <Condition ID = IsAnyObjectFound    /> <Action ID = ApproachClosestObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToRandomLocation    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectVisible? THEN
			DO ApproachObject
	ELSE
			IF IsObjectReachable? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
			IF IsObjectHeavy? THEN
			DO MoveObjectToDestination
	ELSE
		DO ProcessObjectTask
	END
